query.name: ca.myblueprint.dem.coursemaster
query.sql: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT '' AS school_ids ,'' AS powerscheduler_school_ids ,1 AS hs_courses_only FROM dual ), yr AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) - CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM')) < 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END - 1990 AS yearid FROM dual ), src AS ( SELECT c.ID AS course_id ,c.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number ,sc.SCHOOLID AS schoolid FROM COURSES c LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN yr ON 1=1 INNER JOIN SCHOOL_COURSE sc ON sc.COURSEID = c.ID WHERE sc.STATUS = 1 AND sc.YEARID IN (yr.yearid, yr.yearid + 1) AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || sc.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) AND (cfg.powerscheduler_school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.powerscheduler_school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || sc.SCHOOLID || ',') = 0) AND (cfg.hs_courses_only = 0 OR SUBSTR(TRIM(c.CODE), 1, 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') OR NVL(c.CREDIT_HOURS, 0) > 0 OR NVL(c.MAXCREDIT, 0) > 0) UNION SELECT c.ID ,c.COURSE_NUMBER ,scc.SCHOOLID FROM SCHEDULECOURSECATALOGS scc LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 INNER JOIN SCHEDULECATALOGS cat ON scc.COURSECATALOGID = cat.ID AND cat.CURRENTVALUE = 1 INNER JOIN COURSES c ON scc.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE cfg.powerscheduler_school_ids IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.powerscheduler_school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || scc.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0 AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || scc.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) AND (cfg.hs_courses_only = 0 OR SUBSTR(TRIM(c.CODE), 1, 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') OR NVL(c.CREDIT_HOURS, 0) > 0 OR NVL(c.MAXCREDIT, 0) > 0) ), course_rows AS ( SELECT s.schoolid ,c.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number ,c.COURSE_NAME AS course_name ,c.CREDIT_HOURS AS credit_hours ,c.MAXCREDIT AS maxcredit ,c.CODE AS code ,PS_CUSTOMFIELDS.GETCF('Courses', c.ID, 'alt_course_number') AS alt_course_number FROM src s INNER JOIN COURSES c ON c.ID = s.course_id ), codes AS ( SELECT r.schoolid, r.course_name, r.credit_hours, r.maxcredit, r.code ,CASE WHEN TRIM(r.alt_course_number) IS NULL THEN r.course_number WHEN TRIM(r.code) IS NULL THEN TRIM(r.alt_course_number) ELSE TRIM(r.alt_course_number) || '-' || TRIM(r.code) END AS out_course_code ,r.course_number AS out_alt_code FROM course_rows r ) SELECT DISTINCT k.out_course_code AS a_CourseCode ,TO_CHAR(k.schoolid) AS b_SchoolCode ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(k.course_name, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS c_CourseName ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS d_Description ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS e_Discipline ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS f_Department ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS g_Type ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(k.code), 1, 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4') THEN TO_CHAR(8 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(k.code), 1, 1))) END AS h_Grade ,RTRIM(TO_CHAR( CASE WHEN NVL(k.credit_hours, 0) <= 0.001 AND k.maxcredit > 0 THEN k.maxcredit ELSE k.credit_hours END, 'FM9990.999'), '.') AS i_Credit ,k.out_alt_code AS j_AltCourseCode ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS k_CourseID ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS l_GuidanceMessage ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS m_CourseAttribute ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS n_MaxGrade FROM codes k WHERE k.out_course_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b_SchoolCode, a_CourseCode
